en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed new cloud sessions cutting MCP tool descriptions loaded through tool search at 4,096 characters; the limit is now 16,384, as in other Claude Code sessions
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了新的云端 session 将通过工具搜索加载的 MCP 工具描述截断在 4,096 个字符的问题；现在上限为 16,384，与其他 Claude Code session 一致
